name: Jalapeño-Green Goddess Greens with Turkey Meatballs, Avocado & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small pkg fresh basil
½ small pkg chives
½ jalapeño pepper
½ English cucumber
½ bunch radish
½ avocado
½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Divide between a blender and a medium bowl. (Set bowl aside for later use.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Roughly chop chives. Add to the blender.

Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the blender along with mayo, oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Blend on high, adding water 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set dressing aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp mayonnaise
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp honey
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add turkey, bread crumbs, and spices to the reserved bowl with the garlic; using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g ground turkey
½ tsp paprika
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens and feta, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and meatballs between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
